mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.5% within a month signals a tightening monetary policy, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as borrowing costs rise and economic activity slows.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the signal, or the correlation between FEDFUNDS increases and negative SPX returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real GDP over two consecutive quarters indicates strong economic growth, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as corporate earnings improve.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 50% of quarters with positive GDP growth, or the correlation between GDP growth and positive SPX returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate by more than 0.5% within a month signals a tightening labor market, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as consumer spending and corporate earnings improve.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the signal, or the correlation between UNRATE decreases and positive SPX returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production by more than 1% in a month signals increased economic activity, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as corporate earnings improve.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the signal, or the correlation between INDPRO increases and positive SPX returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in housing starts by more than 5% in a month signals a weakening demand in the housing market, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as economic activity slows.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the signal, or the correlation between HOUST decreases and negative SPX returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate is above 4% and the consumer price index increases by more than 0.5% in a month, it signals inflationary pressure coupled with tight monetary policy, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS > 4% and CPIAUCSL increases > 0.5% in 1 month
regime_hint: inflationary pressure with tight monetary policy
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the signal, or the joint effect of high FEDFUNDS and rising CPIAUCSL on negative SPX returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When nonfarm payrolls increase by more than 200,000 in a month and the unemployment rate decreases by more than 0.3%, it signals a strong labor market, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as consumer confidence and spending improve.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS increases > 200,000 in 1 month and UNRATE decreases > 0.3%
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the signal, or the joint effect of PAYEMS increases and UNRATE decreases on positive SPX returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real retail and food services sales by more than 1% over two consecutive months signals strong consumer demand, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as corporate earnings improve.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 50% of periods with positive RSAFS growth, or the correlation between RSAFS growth and positive SPX returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).
